description: Spells level up (use count or XP); evolution at rune forge when runeCombo + conditions match. Pokemon evolution + rune system.

levelUp.description: Each cast adds 1 use; every N uses = +1 level. Content can override to xp per cast.

evolution.description: At rune forge: spell with matching runeCombo can evolve if minLevel (and optionally minAffinity) met. evolutionTable in spell-evolution.json defines result (name, statBonuses, effectIds, isSummon).
